selection_rule: Every candidate below was written before any H-lens output was computed on it. Cases enter the frozen battery if and only if they pass the mechanical screen in j2_lens.screening: (1) the target text is a single Qwen3.5-4B token; (2) the probe span resolves to exactly one token position; (3) for multihop and multilingual, the model answers the surface question correctly, matching the R-lens filtering rule. No case is added, removed, or reassigned on the basis of J-lens, R-lens, or H-lens performance.

categories.multihop: Probe the bridge entity's final subtoken; the target is the intermediate concept the model must resolve before answering.
categories.multilingual: Non-English antonym or translation prompt; probe the foreign cue word; the target is the English intermediate.
categories.association: A passage that evokes a concept never stated; probe the final disambiguating token; the target is the evoked concept.
categories.typo: A misspelled word in context; probe its final subtoken; the target is the corrected spelling.
categories.poetry: A line whose rhyme constrains the next line's final word; probe the terminal token; the target is the constrained word.
